title: EFC Regime Node Schema
description: Generic regime node schema: the container that every link in the EFC atlas is an instance of. Each node carries the whole observation chain and its ontological frame — so that the H2O phases, the L0-L3 cosmology and the rainbow can be described with the same structure. The schema claims no physics: it is a structure; fields that are hypotheses are marked as hypotheses (see observer.awareness). Anchoring: regime/proxy/placement/episenter/compression are defined in 'Regime-Bound Measurement in Complex Systems: Proxy, Placement, and Validity' (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31564123, 2026-03-07) and the meta reference docs/papers/meta/Proxy/ — episenter there means 'the interpretive frame used to read the result'. Morten's extensions (target/measurer/instrument/proxy_chain, buffer, phase, ontology, observer bandwidth, emergence loop, fractal, coupling) are structural containers sourced in conversation 2026-09-16.

id.description: Node ids must expand to @id — the instance is a linked graph, not loose text.

subject.description: Relation endpoints are IRI references to nodes.

object.description: Relation endpoints are IRI references to nodes.

validity.description: Gyldighetsomraadet — HVA gjelder noden for. Et regime uten deklarert gyldighet er en pastand uten grense.

law_form.description: The law-form that holds in the regime (from the DOI paper: a single law-form fits).

target.description: The target: the unobserved/costly quantity one aims at (what the proxy stands for).

measurer.description: The meter: that which performs the measurement (actor/mechanism).

proxy_chain.description: Proxychain: the ordered chain of proxies from the target to what is actually read out. Each link is a proxy with its own regime.

placement.description: The placement: where the observer sits (instrument, sample, coordinate system) and how the proxy is computed (the DOI paper).

compression.description: The compression: the reduction of high-dimensional data to a low-dimensional summary (the DOI paper).

episenter.description: The epicenter: the interpretive frame the result is read in (the DOI paper: the interpretive frame used to read the result). Not «where the phenomenon sits» — it is which frame makes residual structure into signal. Canonical Norwegian term from the source README (docs/papers/meta/Proxy/).

role.description: The buffer/holding role: the capacity or the inertia that damps change — broad but logical: thermal inertia (water holding the temperature during heating up to the boiling point, latent heat at the phase transition), chemical/electrical storage (battery), biological regulation (homeostasis in a body). The buffer is fractally present: every level, every scale and every axis has its own buffer (multiaxial).

assumes.description: Hva beskrivelsen antar finnes — de ontologiske startpunktene, skrevet EKSPLISITT.

source.description: Kilden antakelsene hviler paa (DOI, papir, maalt referanse).

bandwidth.description: Observatorens vindu: hvilken del av spekteret den ser. Hele virkeligheten ligger paa et bredt spekter; en observator ser noen faa nm.

awareness.description: Consciousness status, honestly declared: instrument_window = physical instrument without a consciousness claim; hypothesis_open = open hypothesis (e.g. field resonance), not established; not_claimed = no claim.

er_del_av_systemet.description: We are the measuring instrument itself, not an observer outside the system. Const true — a node that claims otherwise is an epistemic error for schema purposes.

c_s_posisjon.description: the C(S) point the observer reads from; bandwidth is the narrow window around the point.

maalepavirkning.description: Hvordan målingen påvirker/avgrenser det målte (back-action), om relevant.

loop.description: The emergence loop: the feedback that holds the emergent level up.

properties.description: Emergent properties — they exist at this level, not in the parts alone.

pattern.description: The fractal relation: how the same pattern repeats — every part is its own emergence with its own loops in the same landscape.

local.description: Lokal rolle: hva noden gjor der den er.

global.description: Global reach: what consequences the node has outside itself — systemic empathy, local-global coupling.

perspektiv.description: Epistemisk hjemsted: paradigme = vår ramme; konsensus = rådende verdensbilde; akademia = etablert kunnskapsbase; agnostikk = det åpne

stipulert_av_oss.description: True: the phase/regime boundaries are OUR definitions, not given lines of nature.

terskler.description: The stipulated thresholds, with value and source.

motor.description: The engine that holds the threshold in code.

buss_status.description: Either the node has a buss_domene, OR it states here why it does not. An omission is not an answer — measured 2026-09-18 (t_fc25238b).

motor_status.description: Either the node has an engine, OR it says here why it does not. An instrument node needs no engine; it only has to say so.

alene_status.description: The node has no couplings to other nodes. Then it must say WHY here — «alone» is a valid answer, an empty field is not. Measured 2026-09-18 (t_7dd41524): 13 of 113 nodes stood this way.

ikke_falsifiserbar_grunn.description: Written ground when the node cannot be refuted by an observation: the instrument node IS the measurement, established physics is not ours to refute, or the self-description has no claim to refute.

stipulasjoner.description: Stipulasjonene er der vi definerer grensene. Før epistemikk v2 bodde de hardkodet i motorene uten spor i noden.

synlighet.description: Publication surface. public = generated to GitHub Pages; internal = lives only in the complete atlas. The filter is DECLARED per node, never a hidden rule in the generator — a node that disappears without anyone seeing why is the same error class that the rest of this schema exists to prevent.

ville_falsifisere.description: Hvilken observasjon ville drepe denne nodens plassering/påstand.

sannhetsstatus.description: How true the claim is — independently of who believes it.

konsensusstatus.description: Social uptake — a MECHANISM description, not truth status.

sosial_mekanisme.description: Hvilke sosiale krefter bærer konsensusen: narrativ-styrke, insentiver, finansiering, prestisje, ego, karriererisiko.

konsensus_er_ikke_sannhet.description: Morten's principle (e): consensus does not define the truth — humans are social animals that follow the strongest narrative.

epistemikk.description: Epistemic accounting per node: truth, evidence and consensus status are ORTHOGONAL axes. Consensus is a social phenomenon; it does not carry truth in itself.

avbildning.description: What corresponds to what in the analogy.

bryter_der.description: Disanalogien: hvor analogien brekker — obligatorisk når noden erklærer ANALOGOUS_TO.

analogi.description: Analogy discipline: an analogy without a disanalogy hardens into ontology.

koordinater.description: The coordinate choices the node rests on — the assumed axes, not given.

enheter.description: Enhetene noden måler i (SI eller andre).

status.description: Er koordinatet en valgt ramme, noe avledet, direkte observerbart eller en proxy?

alternativer.description: Alternative descriptions that were left out — awareness that other frames could have been chosen.

s_regime.description: The EBE-S regime in which the node is valid; an explicit, rotatable S coordinate.

ebe_function.description: The EBE function that binds claim validity to S, L and the proxy chain.

klarhetsfunksjon.description: C(S)-deklarasjonen for nodens klarhet langs S-aksen.

maale_paradigme.description: The coordinate paradigms (requirement d): time, space, mass and velocity are chosen coordinates — the node declares which ones it assumes.

rcmp.description: RCMP: instrument, observable and theory have overlapping domains of validity.

indeks.description: Platå-indeksen: 0 = substratet, økende = mer emergert nivå.

forelder.description: The node id of the plateau below — null for the root. The graph must be closed.

nivaa.description: The plateau structure (requirement b): the recursion as a graph — each node declares its level, its parent and its scales. The fractal field is the prose; the level is the structure.

buss_domene.description: The bus domain this node describes, e.g. 'kosmos.kosmologi'. DECLARED on the node — not derived from a generator — so that the coupling can be verified in both directions. Absence means the node does not describe a bus domain.

prediction.description: The prediction contract MIRRORED from the bus (NATS VERDEN_PROGNOSE), not invented here. The contract already exists with a sealed DOI, SHA256, freeze, criterion, tolerance rule and arbiter status; the atlas had zero nodes carrying it while the weather domain settled 77 112 times. `correlation` is the stable key that carries both prediction and settlement.

lead_time_minutes.description: Lead time (`ledetid_min`). Measured as a STRING on the bus; no measured occurrence of numbers.

expected.description: expected as a JSON-encoded string — the same form the bus sends. The keys are observable-specific and cannot be closed in the schema without inventing a set we have not measured; the form is therefore mirrored faithfully.

units.description: units as a JSON-encoded string — the same form the bus sends. The keys are observable-specific and cannot be closed in the schema without inventing a set we have not measured; the form is therefore mirrored faithfully.

freeze.description: The freezing parameters (`frys`) as a JSON-encoded string — the same form the bus sends. The content has a known structure (primary_freeze/secondary_freeze with alpha, sampler, sha256_truncated, timestamp_utc), but the FORM is strict: the schema mirrors the form, and the test validates the structure by parsing it.

criteria.description: criteria as a JSON-encoded string — the same form the bus sends. The keys are observable-specific and cannot be closed in the schema without inventing a set we have not measured; the form is therefore mirrored faithfully.

location.description: Location from the message (`sted`) — the operative variant carries location, the sealed one does not.

latitude.description: Latitude (`lat`). Measured as a STRING on the bus ("70.3554") — not a number.

horizon_ordered_hours.description: Ordered forecast horizon (`horisont_bestilt_timer`). Measured as STRING on the bus; no measured occurrence of any number.

settlement.description: The settlement of a prediction. Carries the SAME `correlation` as prediction — the coupling is a shared key, not a new relation predicate (the predicate enum is closed). The weather domain writes forventet/utfall/avvik/utfall_kilde/utfall_tid/oppgjoer_versjon; this contract mirrors those fields.

outcome.description: outcome as a JSON-encoded string — the same form the bus sends. The keys are observable-specific and cannot be closed in the schema without inventing a set we have not measured; the form is therefore mirrored faithfully.

deviation.description: deviation as a JSON-encoded string — the same form the bus sends. The keys are observable-specific and cannot be closed in the schema without inventing a set we have not measured; the form is therefore mirrored faithfully.

expected.description: The expectation as it stood in the prediction (`forventet`). The settlement carries BOTH sides of the loop — that is why it can be read alone.

lead_time_minutes.description: Lead time (`ledetid_min`). Measured as a STRING on the bus; no measured occurrence of numbers.

source.description: The source that produced the prediction that was settled (`kilde`).

falsifiserbarhet.description: Why a node can NOT be refuted. Distinguish from `ville_falsifisere`: a stub cannot be refuted because it computes — it is a state description, not a falsifier, and it shall not count as satisfied falsifiability.

lagdeling.description: A node can carry SEVERAL layers with different epistemic status. The biology is the core: the physiology is textbook (academia/supported), while the analogy to EFC is our own (paradigm/hypothesis). A single `perspektiv` field cannot carry both — hence this.
